content: We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id (integer) for template that when applied to the molecule reproduces the reaction: TMSOTf protecting alcohol to TMS ether. The forward reaction: alcohol + TMSOTf -> TMS ether + TfOH (byproduct). In retrosynthesis, we need to break O-Si bond, forming alcohol precursor. So template should involve O-Si bond formation broken. The functional group broken: aliphatic hydroxyls? Actually forward: alcohol (OH) becomes O-Si (TMS). So broken: O-H bond, formed O-Si bond. The hint says broken is aliphatic hydroxyls. So we need template where aliphatic hydroxyl is broken (i.e., OH removed) and O-Si formed. So functional_groups_broken: aliphatic hydroxyls. functional_groups_formed: trimethylsilyl? maybe "trimethylsilyl". Let's search with both.
